messages:
sarah-support: FYI acme (CS-3542) submitted a DPA erasure 2026-02-10. They want proof: deleted objects + timestamps, KMS/HSM evidence of key destruction, and an exportable audit trail. Customer specifically asked for HSM operator action logs and a signed attestation. Can we produce?

mike-sre: Got it. Quick note — CloudTrail retained 90d in prod but we archive to logging-bucket for 2y. HSM vendor stores operator logs off-site; we'll need vendor attestation for crypto-shred events.

olga-security: Adding myself. We'll need legal sign-off wording for any attestation. HSM vendor contact required; expect 48-72h to get a vendor-signed log extract.

jess-platform: Prep repro steps I'm about to run:
```
# CloudTrail filter
eventName = "DeleteObjectVersion" OR eventName = "DeleteObjects"
eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com"
lookup by tag: "acme" or erasure_job_id=ej-2026-02-10-2198
# KMS filter
eventSource = "kms.amazonaws.com" AND (eventName = "ScheduleKeyDeletion" OR eventName = "GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext")
```
I'll pull CloudTrail IDs + S3 keys and KMS key IDs now.

sarah-support: Customer also asked: "time of irrevocable destruction" and whether HSM did an unwrap/crypto-shred or we just removed metadata. They want the HSM audit session id and operator username.

mike-sre: Our flow: envelope keys are in AWS KMS, KEKs held in on-prem HSM via connector. Erasure job deletes S3 objects, schedules KMS key deletion, and calls HSM delete for KEK. The HSM event may not be in CloudTrail; vendor provides that.

olga-security: I'll draft attestation language and open vendor request. Legal: @sam-legal please weigh in on wording to avoid absolute claims until vendor attests.

sam-legal: Draft suggestion: "Per our records, we executed the customer-specific erasure workflow and removed associated encryption keys. Vendor attestation for on-prem HSM key destruction is pending; we will provide vendor-signed logs when available." Avoid "irrecoverable" until HSM confirms.

jess-platform: Queries run — findings:
- CloudTrail: found DeleteObjectVersion entries for s3://redwood-customer-data-prod/acme/embedding-uuid-... at 2026-02-10T17:06:12Z (eventID: 6f8a2f1c-...).
- KMS: ScheduleKeyDeletion for arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/acme-envelope-xyz at 2026-02-10T17:06:16Z (requestor: svc-erasure).
- Internal index: erasure_job_id=ej-2026-02-10-2198 tied to both events.
- HSM: vendor_ticket=HSM-12877 created (status: pending).
I'll export a csv with columns: CloudTrailEventID, S3Key, DeletionTimestamp, KMSKeyId, ErasureJobId.

sarah-support: Good. Can we provide the customer an initial evidence pack (csv + CloudTrail snippets + KMS event ids) within 24h and tell them HSM attestation ETA 3 business days?

mike-sre: Yes — we can produce the csv and CloudTrail excerpts in ~8 hours. HSM vendor ETA 72-96 hours typical. Mention vendor ETA clearly.

olga-security: I'll open vendor ticket now and cc sam-legal. Will request vendor-signed log extract including HSM session IDs, operator IDs, and action codes for key delete/zeroize.

jess-platform: Starting CSV export. Filter used: `erasure_job_id=ej-2026-02-10-2198` + correlate CloudTrail eventIDs -> will include eventID, s3 key, kmsKeyId, deletion_time. Uploading to secure share when done.

audit-bot: export ready: https://redwood-secure/upload/CS-3542/erasure-evidence-1949998765.csv (access: restricted, expires in 7d)

sarah-support: Thanks. I'll send customer initial reply with timeline and secure link. Will note: csv + cloudtrail/KMS extracts within 24h, HSM attestation pending ~3 business days. Assigning owners: @jess-platform (evidence CSV + cloudtrail), @olga-security (vendor attestation), @mike-sre (backup/snapshot check). I'll take customer communication. :thumbsup:

mike-sre: FYI — snapshots/backups inventory shows 2 AMIs and 1 RDS snapshot with tag=acme created 2025-11-04. I'll coordinate targeted deletion; may require low-impact maintenance window.

olga-security: Opened vendor ticket HSM-12877; vendor acknowledged and requested formal PO/FOI for attestation — we've provided. Estimated delivery 72h.

jess-platform: Uploaded CSV to secure-share. Link above from audit-bot. CSV includes CloudTrail eventIDs + s3 keys + kmsKeyId + erasure_job_id.

sarah-support: Good work. I'll close loop after HSM attestation and snapshot deletions confirmed. Owner: sarah-support.

olga-security: ack, will update thread when vendor attestation arrives.

sam-legal: Standing by to review final attestation text before sending to customer.

sarah-support: replying to customer now with timeline and secure link. Close here for internal updates.
